title: DirectX 8 for Visual Basic
description: Microsoft's DirectX 8 for Visual Basic (dx8vb.dll, version 5.03.2600.2180 from Windows XP SP2), registered once for every game that needs it. Many Visual Basic 6 audio games use it for sound and input; Windows Vista and later don't include it, and those games then stop with "Class not registered" or a missing dx8vb.dll.
